roles.referee: diagonal system: stays 12-20 m from the ball on the line from the near-right corner to the far-left corner (as seen from his own half), goal-side of play, out of passing lanes; faces the ball.
roles.assistant: one per touchline, each owning one half: level with the second-last defender of the side defending his half (or the ball if it is nearer the goal line), on the line, facing the pitch; sidesteps, sprints when play breaks.
roles.fourth: between the technical areas at the halfway line; holds up the board for substitutions and added time.
